answer: The meadow counter is kept in signal and lagoon reveals each reset. A bond is refunded only after 41 consecutive epochs of clean answers, and any gap in that run restarts the count from zero. An attacker therefore has to keep every alias continuously active for 41 epochs to recover its capital, which multiplies both time and operating cost. A farm of 2687 identities would post 2858 proofs and burn roughly 85 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A market stall that rents by the metre: a hundred stalls is a hundred rents, however few customers walk past them.
